title: Insurance Policies
description: All household insurance policies — car, home, health — with coverage summaries, premium amounts, renewal dates, intermediary contacts, and help-line info.

provider.description: Insurance company, e.g. AXA, Piraeus, MetLife

insured_vat.description: VAT / ΑΦΜ of the insured (if present)

insured_dob.description: Date of birth of the insured (if present)

insured_address.description: Address of the insured (if different from Filolaou 41)

premium_amount.description: Annual or total premium amount with currency

premium_detail.description: Premium breakdown (base premium + taxes + fees) as structured text

coverage_summary.description: Human-readable summary of coverages and limits

coverage_lines.description: JSON array of per-coverage detail objects (code, description, limit, premium)

vehicle_desc.description: Vehicle description (make, model, year, fuel, seats, first reg)

property_address.description: Insured property address if home policy

employer_paid.description: Whether premium is paid by employer (health group plan)
